title: Staffing policy catalog
description: Top-level catalog of governance policy records: never-automatic rules, role-scoped model rules, role-to-class mappings, role floors, reviewer independence rules, and spend caps. This schema defines shape only: it encodes no model ids, roles, role classes, tiers, decisions, or dollar caps; those arrive later as cited data. Every authoritative policy rule requires a nonempty decision and a nonempty source citation. Class metadata MUST NOT map to a preferred model or route: it may only join comparable evidence and determine whether an unevidenced cheap trial is permitted (D206). A class-to-model or class-to-route mapping is forbidden here. Role-class governance is not task-class model preference: role_class entries state which governance class a role belongs to, never which model or route a task class should use. No selection, ranking, probabilities, or class preferences are expressible in this schema. Unknown fields are rejected strictly.

never_automatic.description: Rules declaring that a model/effort combination must never be used without an explicit, non-automatic decision. Array entries must be pairwise distinct.

role_scoped.description: Model rules scoped by role classes: which role classes are allowed and which are denied for a given model. The direction of scoping is model-to-roles only; nothing here may be read as class-to-model or class-to-route preference. Allowed and denied role-class sets are expected to be disjoint; disjointness across entries is a data-quality concern for the cited decision, not something this schema can enforce. Array entries must be pairwise distinct.

role_class.description: Role-to-class mapping entries: each entry assigns one governance role class to one role. This is role-to-class governance only. It MUST NOT be interpreted as a mapping from a class to a model or route, and it is not task-class model preference. Array entries must be pairwise distinct.

role_floors.description: Role-floor records shaped after the archived tier policy. Floor labels are opaque stable strings; no tier names, ordering, or values are enumerated or baked in here. Array entries must be pairwise distinct.

reviewer_independence.description: Reviewer independence rules in one of exactly three archived shapes, expressed as a strict oneOf union: (A) worker separation with a different-family requirement or preference; (B) a scalar fresh-eyes mode; (C) a second-opinion mode. Mixing mode fields from different variants is forbidden. Every variant carries a nonempty decision and a nonempty source citation. Array entries must be pairwise distinct.

spend_caps.description: Nonnegative spend caps with a unit and a scope. Units and scopes are opaque stable strings; no unit or scope vocabulary is enumerated here. Array entries must be pairwise distinct.

reserve_fraction.description: Subscription-channel reserve fraction (D216). A default value (0.10) applies to every subscription channel; per-channel overrides may override the default for a named channel_id. When a channel's remaining_fraction in any binding window is at or below its reserve, the channel's routes are excluded from automatic staffing with the reason `reserve: N% kept in the tank (D216)`. The reserve is a policy floor, distinct from the availability reader's health heuristics (`likely_exhausted` below 10%, which stays as a fail-safe). `bind` may still use a reserved channel only with `--authorized-by lee`. Every policy rule and reason must cite D216.

default.description: Default reserve fraction (0.0 to 1.0) applied to every subscription channel that has no explicit per-channel override. D216 sets the default to 0.10.

overrides.description: Optional per-channel overrides of the default reserve fraction. Each entry names a channel_id and its explicit reserve fraction (0.0 to 1.0). Anthropic and Gemini are explicitly 0.10 per D216. Array entries must be pairwise distinct by channel_id.

crew_ordering_rule.description: Named-crew ordering rule: within a role's array, order by marginal price at authoring time with prepaid-first as the tie-break; a human may pin otherwise with a stated reason (D215 ruling 3). Field is a single object with nonempty decision and source.

human_escalation_cost_usd.description: Terminal human-escalation cost in USD for staffing ladder arithmetic (D211 ruling 3). The current value is the Chief's placeholder; Lee may change it, so the schema fixes only the shape: a finite nonnegative number (JSON Schema numbers are finite by construction; the loader additionally rejects the non-finite floats YAML permits, such as .nan and .inf). The current committed value lives in policy.yaml, not here.

stableRef.description: A stable, nonempty identifier: starts with an alphanumeric character, then alphanumerics, dots, underscores, colons, hyphens, or slashes (permitting qualified references such as slash-joined model ids). No whitespace is permitted.

isoDate.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD with month and day ranges enforced).

neverAutomaticRule.description: One never-automatic rule for a model, optionally narrowed to a specific effort level. When effort is absent, the rule is model-level and covers all effort levels of the model. Model and effort are opaque references; no ids are enumerated here.

model_ref.description: Stable opaque reference to the model this rule covers.

effort.description: Optional stable opaque effort level this rule covers (for example a named effort tier; any nonempty stable string, including a catch-all label, is data). Absent means the rule applies at the model level.

decision.description: Nonempty statement of the decided rule (what is forbidden without an explicit non-automatic decision).

source.description: Nonempty citation for this rule (decision record, archive note, or equivalent provenance).

roleScopedRule.description: One model rule scoped by role classes with explicit allowed and denied class lists. Direction is model-to-roles; a class-to-model mapping is forbidden and cannot be expressed here.

model_ref.description: Stable opaque reference to the model being scoped.

allowed_role_classes.description: Role classes explicitly allowed to use this model. Class keys are opaque stable strings; no class vocabulary is enumerated here.

denied_role_classes.description: Role classes explicitly denied use of this model. Expected to be disjoint from allowed_role_classes.

decision.description: Nonempty statement of the decided scoping rule.

source.description: Nonempty citation for this rule (decision record, archive note, or equivalent provenance).

roleClassEntry.description: One role-to-class mapping entry. Governance classification of a role only; it must never be read as a preference of any model or route for a class.

role_ref.description: Stable opaque reference to the role being classified.

role_class.description: Stable opaque governance class assigned to the role. Class metadata may only join comparable evidence and determine whether an unevidenced cheap trial is permitted (D206); it may never select a model or route.

decision.description: Nonempty statement of the decided classification.

source.description: Nonempty citation for this classification (decision record, archive note, or equivalent provenance).

roleFloorRecord.description: One role-floor record shaped after the archived tier policy. The floor is an opaque stable label; no tier vocabulary, ordering, or numeric values are baked in here.

role_ref.description: Stable opaque reference to the role the floor applies to.

floor.description: Opaque stable floor label (tier-level name or equivalent) as decided by the archived tier policy; the value itself is cited data, not schema.

effective_from.description: Optional ISO date from which this floor is effective. Archived floors without a recorded date simply omit this field.

decision.description: Nonempty statement of the decided floor.

source.description: Nonempty citation for this floor (archived tier policy, decision record, or equivalent provenance).

reviewerIndependenceRule.description: One reviewer independence rule. Exactly one of the three archived shapes must match: worker-separation/family preference, scalar fresh-eyes mode, or second-opinion mode. All variants require reviewer_ref, decision, and source.

oneOf.description: Shape A: worker separation with an explicitly declared different-family preference. False permits a different review route in the author's family; the author route itself remains excluded.

not_same_worker_as.description: Stable opaque reference to the worker this reviewer must not be (the not_same_worker_as constraint).

prefer_different_family.description: Whether review requires a different model family. The declaration is required; false is an explicit same-family review opt-in.

oneOf.description: Shape B: the archived scalar fresh-eyes mode; no worker list or family field is present.

fresh_eyes_mode.description: The archived scalar fresh-eyes mode value; the only faithfully expressible value is the archived one.

oneOf.description: Shape C: the archived second-opinion mode object; no worker list or family field is present.

second_opinion_mode.description: The archived second-opinion mode value; the only faithfully expressible value is the archived one.

reviewerRef.description: Stable opaque reference to the reviewer the rule applies to.

independenceDecision.description: Nonempty statement of the decided independence requirement.

independenceSource.description: Nonempty citation for this rule (decision record, archive note, or equivalent provenance).

reserveOverride.description: Per-channel override of the default reserve fraction (D216). Each entry names a single channel_id and the reserve fraction applied to it instead of the default.

channel_id.description: Stable opaque reference to the subscription channel this override applies to.

reserve_fraction.description: Reserve fraction (0.0 to 1.0) for this channel. D216 sets Anthropic and Gemini to 0.10 explicitly.

crewOrderingRule.description: Named-crew ordering rule recorded in policy.yaml (D215 ruling 3). A single required object with nonempty decision and source; not an array.

decision.description: Nonempty statement of the decided ordering rule.

source.description: Nonempty citation for this rule (decision record, archive note, or equivalent provenance).

spendCap.description: One nonnegative spend cap with an opaque unit and scope. No unit, scope, or dollar-cap values are enumerated or baked in here.

cap.description: The cap value: a finite nonnegative number. Currency or unit interpretation comes from unit, not from this schema.

unit.description: Opaque stable unit of the cap (for example a currency-and-period label); vocabulary is data, not schema.

scope.description: Opaque stable scope the cap applies to (for example a role, channel, or global label); vocabulary is data, not schema.

effective_from.description: Optional ISO date from which this cap is effective.

decision.description: Nonempty statement of the decided cap.

source.description: Nonempty citation for this cap (decision record, archive note, or equivalent provenance).
